description: This script automates running Cypress tests with retry logic, parallel distribution, and optional dashboard integration for the Superset project.

methods.name: generate_build_id
methods.description: Creates a build ID string based on the current timestamp and environment variables.

methods.name: run_cypress_for_test_file
methods.description: Executes Cypress tests for a specified test file with retries, optional dashboard recording, and dry-run capability.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, discovers test files, distributes them across groups, and runs tests for the specified group.
